-respondents.

Act, and Section 67 of Information Technology Himank Sharma And 4 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197453466/

4. Perused the settlement agreement dated 31.07.2024 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 7 of the settlement agreement dated 31.07.2024

The paragraph 7 is quoted as under:-
"7) In view of the Interim Settlement Agreement dated 03.07.2024, the following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have settled their dispute and mutually decided to live separately and in this regard they have filed a petition u/s 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Aligarh and the same is registered as Marriage Petition No. 1143 of 2024.
The certified copy of the aforesaid divorce petition is annexed to this settlement for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.

b) That it has been agreed between the parties that the petitioner no. 1-husband shall pay an amount of Rs. 15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh only) to the wife towards permanent alimony including Stridhan and all other financial claims that may accrue against the petitioner no. 1-husband and his family members.
The aforesaid amount shall be paid by way of demand draft.

c) That on 03.07.2024, the petitioner no. 1-husband has produced a demand draft bearing no. 613013 dated 01.07.2024 drawn on IDFC First Bank for Rs.7,50,000/-
(Rupees Seven Lakh Fifty Thousand only) in favour of Ayasha Gautam (wife) which is kept on record and the same has been handed over to the wife today i.e. 31.07.2024 and she has acknowledged the receipt of the same.

d) That it has been agreed between the parties that the remaining amount i.e.
Rs.7,50,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakh Fifty Thousand only) shall be paid by Himank Sharma (Petitioner No. 1-Husband) to Smt. Ayasha Gautam (Respondent No. 3-Wife)
at the time of final judgment in Marriage Petition No. 1143 of 2024 pending in Family Court, Aligarh by way of demand draft.

"e) That it has also been agreed between the parties that all civil and criminal cases filed by them against each other regarding present matrimonial dispute shall be withdrawn by the parties concerned by taking appropriate steps.
f) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this matrimonial dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also."

Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
(2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 31.07.2024 the First Information Report dated 02.02.2024, registered as Case Crime No. 0032 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354 (kha), 342 IPC, under Section 3/4 D.P. Act, and Section 67 of Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008, Police Station Civil Lines, District Aligarh is hereby quashed.
7.
